empty.title: Nothing to check yet
empty.text: Checks run a model version on an image, a dataset, a video or the screen. A version appears after a successful training run.

caption: Weights best.pt of version {{number}} · input {{width}} × {{height}} px · classes: {{classes}}. A check takes the GPU like training does: while training runs, a check does not start, and training started during a check waits in the queue.

fields.maxDetections: Detections per frame (empty — all model candidates)

validation.confidence: The confidence threshold is a number from 0 to 1.
validation.maxDetections: Detections per frame is a positive integer or empty (Auto).
validation.device: The device is CPU or a GPU index.

stopReason.project_switched: stopped on switching to another project

image.title: Image check
image.text: The version weights run on one whole PNG, JPEG, WebP or BMP image: Ultralytics resizes it to the {{size}} px input without cropping. Boxes are drawn over the image.

screen.title: Real-time screen check
screen.text: Take a screenshot and place the {{width}} × {{height}} px frame where objects appear. The frame is captured at the given rate and run through the model until the check is stopped or the time runs out. A game must run in borderless windowed mode: Windows does not capture exclusive fullscreen.
screen.whole: The {{width}} × {{height}} screen is not larger than the model input: it is captured whole.
screen.fpsInvalid: Frames per second is a number above 0 and up to 60.
screen.durationInvalid: Stop after is from 1 second to 24 hours (in minutes).
screen.captureFirst: Take a screenshot first to place the frame.
screen.fpsHint: 2–5 frames per second is usually enough; more loads the GPU harder.
screen.previewNote: Frame {{time}} — the picture refreshes once a second.

video.title: Video check
video.text: MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WebM or M4V video. Frames are taken in order at the given step, without seeking. If the video is larger than the model input, a {{width}} × {{height}} px frame is cut from each frame — the model is trained on exactly such frames.
video.prompt: Choose a video to get a sample frame for the crop.
video.name: Video
video.whole: The video is not larger than the model input: the whole frame is checked.
video.stepInvalid: The step is a positive number of seconds (at least 1 ms).
video.stepTooLong: The step is longer than the video: only the first frame will be checked.
video.truncated: The journal keeps the first {{kept}} of {{total}} frames with detections; the per-class summary covers all frames.

dataset.compared: Versions to compare on one dataset

evaluation.title: Dataset check
evaluation.text: The version weights (best.pt) run on the chosen split of a project dataset, so versions trained on different datasets are compared on the same frames. Ultralytics computes the metrics as in training. The check takes the GPU in the shared queue with training.
evaluation.noUsable: No datasets to check on: build a dataset. Archived and corrupt ones do not qualify.
evaluation.batchInvalid: The batch size is an integer from 1 to 1024.
evaluation.splitFrames_one: {{frames}} frame in the {{split}} split. The input size comes from the version.
evaluation.splitFrames_other: {{frames}} frames in the {{split}} split. The input size comes from the version.
evaluation.comparisonEmpty: The comparison appears after the first successful dataset check.
evaluation.listEmpty: No checks yet. Choose a version and a dataset above.
evaluation.classesNote: Classes without objects in this split are not shown: no metric is computed for them.
evaluation.loadFailed: Could not load the dataset checks. Load them again.
